Description

Uncertainty island is located on far west side of Ferwater Island behind the mountains. It can be accessed by swimming around the whole island, walking over the mountain or by using grabby grabber flight glitch.

The island has multiple lightslate nodes with ink as well as palm trees which are located on the beach.

In the middle there is a sign which says "UNCERTAINTY ISLAND".

Trivia

  • Uncertainty island is not actually an island as it's connected to the Ferwater island.
  • It can be used as a way to farm inkstone, but it will be very inefficient because there is no way for vehicles to get here.
  • Appears to be mainly an easter egg for curious players, but it may have a proper function in a future update.
